a.propos.createur.texte: Doctor, with over 25 years’ experience in the humanitarian field — negotiating access to conflict zones and complex emergencies. I taught myself to code and develop these applications on my own: it’s a personal passion of mine to make cultural heritage understandable, properly sourced and accessible. The subscription fee covers infrastructure and basic running costs (hosting, data, sources).

a.propos.rich.au.fil.du.parcours: As you go along, the app allows you to keep track of your visit and document it:
a.propos.rich.ce.pays.ne.se: This country isn’t just a place to visit; it’s a story to be told. Behind every monument, every village and every landscape lie centuries of history, each layer building upon the last. This app is your guide to help you uncover them: it brings together more than 500 sites and places listed across the country, categorised by type, to turn your stay into a true journey of discovery — a thread to follow, from one place to the next, with the right insight to help you understand each one.
a.propos.rich.chaque.lieu.vient.avec: Each site comes with a clear, well-sourced information sheet: what you can see there, when it dates from, and tips for visiting. The sites are organised so you can find your way around at a glance:
a.propos.rich.de.quoi.ceux.qu: Everything you need to organise your visits and plan those little detours to perfection — the ones you don’t expect, but which are the real highlight of any trip. The trip takes on a playful quality: you follow the trail, tick off the stops, and let yourself be surprised. And above all, you treat yourself to a genuine immersion in the country and its people, getting as close as possible to the heart of what makes it come alive.
a.propos.rich.en.aucun.cas.il: Under no circumstances will it be shared without your explicit consent. And if you choose not to share any information, your refusal will not result in any reduction in the services offered: you will be able to use the app in exactly the same way.
a.propos.rich.l.application.qui.sont: The app complements and supports the on-site guides, who are usually trained to provide you with the most detailed information, a vivid narrative and anecdotes that no screen can replace. It prepares you for the tour and extends the experience; the guide, for their part, brings it to life. The two go hand in hand.
a.propos.rich.le.but.est.simple: The aim is simple: to help you see more and understand better, without missing anything that was right next to you. The choice is yours:
a.propos.rich.tout.ce.que.vous: Everything you create — routes, photos, videos, notes — remains your property and is always stored on your device.

a.propos.transformez.le.tout.en: Turn it all into a keepsake album, which you can share with your friends and family in a variety of formats.
